bounded_claims.text: Brown University has a public record that warrants context: OCR voluntary resolution agreement announced.
Brown University announced a voluntary agreement with the U.S. Department of Education's Office for Civil Rights related to alleged shared-ancestry harassment, including antisemitism.

unknowns: CEL reports only the public response located in the cited record; it does not independently evaluate the underlying conduct.

sources.title: Brown reaches agreement that resolves OCR complaint alleging antisemitism

institutional_response.text: Brown said it agreed to continue nondiscrimination training, investigator training, policy clarification, and reporting commitments under the OCR resolution agreement.

claim_limit: Public-source documentation is not a finding of misconduct, prevalence measure, school ranking, safety score, or legal conclusion by CEL.
